text:
kevin: Heads-up — I'm about to land a TF change that creates a new ConfigMap `model-runtime-flags` per model (via for_each). Wanted a quick sanity check on rollout strategy and secrets wiring before I apply. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infrastructure/pulls/548 :eyes:

kevin: TL;DR — configmap contains runtime knobs (max_seq, kv_cache_enabled, quant_profile). We annotate pods with `redwood.com/config-checksum` so stateful pods should rotate on change. Plan output snippet below:
```
# aws-k8s provider plan snippet
+ kubernetes_config_map.model_flags["gptx-13b"]
  data.max_seq: "1024"
  data.kv_cache_enabled: "true"
  metadata.annotations.redwood.com/config-checksum: "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e"
```

maria: quick q — are we mounting this as a file or env? If file, are any in-pod watchers expecting an inotify event or are we relying on checksum-based restart?

kevin: mounting as a file at `/etc/redwood/model-flags.yaml` for now. We use an init container to copy -> config dir and the sidecar (tiny watcher) checks checksum env var and triggers SIGHUP for processes that support it. No live inotify relied on.

sam: ping @kevin — two things: (1) If TF creates many per-model ConfigMaps we'll hit k8s object limits in some clusters. Can we collapse into a single ConfigMap with keys `gptx-13b.yaml` etc and have the pod pick the right key? (2) Secrets: any sensitive knobs? If we reference any API keys, we must use Secret refs not plain data.

kevin: good catches. (1) I considered single CM approach but wanted per-model granularity for targeting rollouts. We could compromise: per-model keys in a single CM for smaller clusters, and per-model CMs in large clusters. I'll add a feature flag to TF to toggle strategy. (2) No API keys in this CM — only toggles and numeric knobs. For secret-backed values we create k8s Secret and mount separately.

jenna: infra-bot, can you run the cluster-limits quick-check for `staging` and `prod` to confirm object counts? :robot_face:

infra-bot: run started by jenna — checking k8s object counts in clusters (staging, prod). ETA ~ 45s.

infra-bot: staging: 6,102 ConfigMaps (OK for now). prod: 9,850 ConfigMaps (warning: close to soft threshold 10k). Recommendation: prefer single-CM toggle for prod or request quota bump.

maria: thanks infra-bot. Given prod warning, I'd prefer single-CM-per-cluster for now to avoid emergency quotas. We can use per-model keys and keep the same checksum annotation pattern on the pod to trigger restarts when the cluster-level CM changes for that model key.

kevin: sounds reasonable. I'll change the TF module to support two modes (per-model-CM vs consolidated-CM) and default to `consolidated` for prod via workspace var. I'll also add a doc snippet in the PR about how the watcher picks keys: `model = env.REDWOOD_MODEL` -> read key `models/${model}.yaml`.

sam: also add unit test to TF that ensures annotation is set and a small note in the runtime README about watcher behavior.

kevin: will do. Plan to re-run `terraform plan -var='consolidated=true'` and post plan diff here before apply. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jenna: :shipit: when green and infra-bot passes quota checks.

kevin: tagging the PR with `needs-qa` and `infra-approval` labels.
